title: Custom filter's connector calls `dispose()` function right after the initial render.

comments.body:
It was found that the `dispose()` calls were a result of changing the "widget params".

Consider there's a custom widget called `<ItemsOfSpecificColorFilter specificColor={color}/>`.
It filters by `item.color === specificColor`.

So `itemsOfSpecificColorFilter()` function (in the connector function implementation) receives a `widgetParams` object from which it can read the `specificColor` parameter.

The weird thing is that whenever `specificColor` property changes, the connector's  `dispose()` function is called, causing the `initialUiState` filter value to be discarded. I.e. it `dispose()`s of the custom filter connector every time any of the connector parameters are changed.

This type of behavior is not cool and we consider it a bug.
